headline: Spend rose $711 (28.2%) week over week; $580 of it is unexplained.
paragraphs: Amazon OpenSearch Service is new this week at $310. Cost Anomaly Detection flagged it.
EC2 - Other rose $270, from $120 to $390. Cost Anomaly Detection points at NatGateway-Bytes in us-east-1, which is data moving through a NAT gateway.
Spend with no team tag grew from $135 to $296, so part of this week's increase has no owner.
assumptions: The OpenSearch domain was created on purpose. The data does not say who created it.
The NAT gateway traffic comes from a new or changed workload. The data does not name it.
